title: Chat messages
description: The parts of a conversation, to compose your own chat: UserMessage, AssistantMessage (+ ChatAnswer for a ChatItem), ChatThinking, ChatError, ChatCopyButton, ChatAvatar, ChatIntro, ChatSuggestion(s), ChatList and ChatComposer.
when: A chat that does not fit AIChat's layout; AI output inside another feature.
a11y: ChatList keeps scroll position while the user reads up and offers “jump to latest”; ChatComposer is a labelled textarea with send / stop buttons.
